quiz.question_pt: ¿Qué palabra completa: 'She's been living here ___ May'?
¿Qué significa 'What have you been doing lately?'

data_es.tip_pt: Usa have/has + been + verbo-ing. Con 'for' indicas duración; con 'since', el punto de inicio. Los verbos de estado (know, like) no usan esta forma.

items.pt: He estado trabajando todo el día.

items.en: She's been living here since May.
It's been raining for a week.

common_mistake.right: I have been working here for five years.
common_mistake.wrong: I am working here since five years.
common_mistake.why_pt: Para duración hasta ahora, usa present perfect, no presente.
